monitoring_catalog.description: 6. Deployment | Monitoring store catalog for drift and performance tracking. Use the same catalog and schema in every project so all models appear in one dashboard. Leave blank to start without monitoring; enable it later in deployment/variables.yml

monitoring_schema.description: 6. Deployment | Monitoring store schema inside that catalog, shared by all projects (for example skyulf_monitoring, not this project's own schema); required with a catalog, blank when monitoring is off. Created on first use when the run-as identity may create schemas
